unit.unitinstructions:
Tennessee Recommended Native Plants

Practice identifying Tennessee recommended native plants from photos sourced from the Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center.

  • What you will do: Each card shows a plant photo, and you type the first listed common name for that species.
  • Image source: Images were downloaded from the Wildflower Center image archive for local MoFaCTS hosting; no remote image links are used for prompts.
  • Attribution: Plant names and photos are attributed to the Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center Tennessee Recommended collection: https://www.wildflower.org/collections/printable_QR_main.php?collection=TN.
  • How it works: Feedback appears immediately so you can connect each photo to the correct common name.

Look for flower shape, leaf arrangement, bark, growth habit, and color cues, then begin when you are ready.
